content.query: AppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "turn_feedback_saved" | summarize up = countif(tostring(Properties["rating"]) == "up"), down = countif(tostring(Properties["rating"]) == "down") by projectId = tostring(Properties["projectId"]), day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | extend downRatePct = round(100.0 * down / (up + down), 1)
content.title: Thumbs up and down per project per day, with the down rate

content.query: AppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "turn_feedback_saved" and tostring(Properties["rating"]) == "down" | summarize n = count() by category = tostring(Properties["category"])
content.title: Negative feedback by category

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.summary.rebuilds", "docchat.summary.truncated") | summarize n = sum(Sum) by Name, outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"])
content.title: Summary rebuilds by outcome

content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.conversations.ensure_post_turn_work" | extend tokens = todouble(Properties["docchat.history.unsummarised_tokens"]) | where isnotnull(tokens) | summarize p50 = percentile(tokens, 50), p95 = percentile(tokens, 95), turns = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Unsummarised tokens p50 and p95

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.memory.extractions", "docchat.memory.fact_rejections") | summarize n = sum(Sum) by Name, detail = coalesce(tostring(Properties["outcome"]), tostring(Properties["reason"]))
content.title: Memory extractions by outcome and rejections by reason

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.memory.fact_screenings" | summarize n = sum(Sum) by source = tostring(Properties["source"]), outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"])
content.title: Memory fact screenings by source and outcome

content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and AppRoleName == "docchat-api" and isnotnull(Properties["docchat.cosmos.request_charge"]) | extend ru = todouble(Properties["docchat.cosmos.request_charge"]) | summarize p50 = percentile(ru, 50), p95 = percentile(ru, 95), calls = sum(ItemCount) by Name | order by calls desc
content.title: Request charge per operation, p50 and p95

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.conversations.abandoned", "docchat.conversations.finalize_superseded", "docchat.conversations.duplicates", "docchat.conversations.trace_truncated", "docchat.conversations.followups_not_saved") | summarize n = sum(Sum) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Abandoned, superseded and duplicate turns

content.query: CDBDataPlaneRequests | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and DatabaseName == "docchat" and AadPrincipalId != "{apiPrincipalId}" | summarize requests = count(), firstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), lastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by AadPrincipalId, CollectionName, OperationName
content.title: Human access to conversation data
